mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at Verona Community Park with a temperature of 27 degrees and a First Quarter moon overhead.

The Verona Municipal Court reminds residents that you can pay most traffic citations online, though O W I tickets require an appearance. Additionally, the Plan Commission is meeting December 7 to review development plans at Liberty Business Park.
While there are no events scheduled for the next 30 days, we will be sure to update you as soon as new city gatherings are announced.
In a noteworthy call from October 21, officers assisted fire and EMS departments during two separate witnessed cardiac arrest incidents.
The flavor of the day is Chocolate Volcano. Since the store is currently closed, please note that it opens today at 10:00 AM.
